category_match: The management routes contain complete real workflows, but they do not yet read as one Intercom-derived operations family.
differences: Filters and workflow controls use inconsistent padding, radii and hierarchy between routes.
Many ordinary rows are rendered as separate cards instead of one bordered surface with shared dividers.
Primary actions still use the previous saturated treatment instead of the restrained charcoal workspace control.
Import and rename workflows lack the same compact section headers and continuous work surfaces used by the redesigned operations routes.
Held and Turned down are implemented through a shared component, but their route surfaces need a consistent management context without changing that component's behavior.
Mobile controls work but do not consistently fill available width or retain 44px targets.
planned_changes: Apply consistent Library management eyebrows and route headers.
Use compact bordered filter and workflow surfaces with 1px row dividers.
Use charcoal for ordinary primary actions while preserving semantic warnings and destructive confirmations.
Retain every API call, permission gate, URL filter, polling loop, progress state and confirmation flow.
Stack controls and preserve at least 44px touch targets on narrow screens.
reasoning: These pages already expose the necessary functionality. The smallest safe redesign is a route-scoped visual normalization that improves density and hierarchy without moving logic into new components or changing backend contracts.
